module_summary: 8-bit ripple-carry adder built from two chained 4-bit adder instances, the low nibble's carry-out feeding the high nibble's carry-in.

anchors.name: a
anchors.why: 8-bit operand a, split into nibbles for the two add4 instances.

anchors.name: b
anchors.why: 8-bit operand b, split into nibbles for the two add4 instances.

anchors.name: y
anchors.why: 8-bit sum assembled from the two add4 nibble results.

anchors.name: Co_temp
anchors.why: Ripple carry from low-nibble adder into high-nibble adder carry-in.

groups.name: ripple_adder_chain
groups.description: Two add4 stages chained through Co_temp to form an 8-bit adder.
